title: The Relationships between Active Galactic Nucleus Power and Molecular Gas Mass within 500 pc of the Center of Elliptical Galaxies
question: Which physical quantity controls AGN feedback in elliptical galaxies: how does molecular gas mass within 500 pc of the center relate to AGN jet power, continuum luminosity and black hole mass, and does the P_cav-M_mol relation extend from BCGs to non-central ellipticals?

recipe.goal: calibrate, continuum-subtract and image archival data
recipe.method: Calibrate with CASA and the ALMA Pipeline, subtract continuum with uvcontsub, image line cubes and continuum with tclean (Briggs robust 2)

recipe.goal: make integrated-intensity images and identify detections
recipe.method: immoments integrated-intensity images for the 13 galaxies; CO detected in 6

recipe.goal: measure CO line flux or 3-sigma upper limit
recipe.method: Extract spectra of the emission regions; derive line flux density from the brightness of the integrated-intensity images (not Gaussian fits); 3-sigma upper limits for non-detections
key_parameters: IC 4296 channels with prominent absorption ignored
Upper-limit line assumed within +-500 km/s of the galaxy velocity

recipe.goal: convert CO flux to molecular gas mass within 500 pc
recipe.method: M_mol from S_CO Delta v with the Bolatto et al. 2013 relation, with F_ul excitation correction, X_CO and luminosity distance; 3-sigma upper bounds for non-detections

recipe.goal: derive continuum luminosities L_con and L_1.4
recipe.method: L_con from ALMA line-free-channel continuum flux, K-corrected to the CO(1-0) frequency with a power law; L_1.4 from literature 1.4 GHz fluxes
assumptions: Power-law continuum S_nu proportional to (nu/nu_10)^gamma, gamma = -0.75

recipe.goal: test and fit correlations of M_mol with P_cav, L_con, L_1.4
recipe.method: Kendall rank correlation on log scales and power-law regression including upper limits, using R package NADA

recipe.goal: repeat the P_cav-M_mol test within 250 pc
recipe.method: Recompute M_mol within 250 pc for all NCEGs and 5 BCGs and repeat the correlation test

recipe.goal: test whether black hole mass drives jet power
recipe.method: Correlate literature M_BH with P_cav for all 22 galaxies

recipe.goal: assess the origin of the mm/submm continuum
recipe.method: Compare F_con/F_1.4 ratios and overplot a power-law plus modified blackbody SED normalised to NGC 5044; t-test of NCEG vs BCG ratios
